text:
alin: quick flag - onboarded micro-ranker-v1 int8 to staging. ndcg@10 +0.014, mrr@1 -0.028. opening thread to triage.

marta: weird pattern. likely ties or tiny score shifts pushing wrong doc to top. did you run fp32 on same ids?

alin: yes fp32 run on identical ids. seed=7, batch=192, kvpack=true. candidate exports match checksum for most docs.

devops-bot: "alert: quant-runtime: determinism flag unset on staging"

chen: set determinism=true and re-run. also capture score histograms and exact-equality tie counts at rank1.

marta: check tokenizer casing and html-strip versions too; we've seen parser diffs cause surprising swaps.

alin: after determinism=true, mrr gap reduced to -0.01. histograms show slight compression around the top-5 scores vs fp32. tie_count@1 down 40% but not equal.

sam: two paths: quick mitigation = tiny score rescale (1.015) for int8; long fix = adjust final-layer accumulation precision or candidate pipeline parity.

alin: pushing rescale canary and running bootstrap CI (1000 resamples). uploading artifacts to s3://rerank-triage/6954321000.

marta: add an onboarding checklist item: "verify candidate-parser and export timestamp parity". keep this thread updated.
